dhp100:2: Though there are a thousand sayings consisting of useless words,
dhp100:3: better is one useful word hearing which one is brought to peace.
dhp101:1: Though there are a thousand verses consisting of useless words,
dhp101:3: better is one word of a verse hearing which one is brought to peace.
dhp102:2: One may speak a hundred verses consisting of useless words,
dhp102:3: better is one verse of Dhamma, hearing which one is brought to peace.
dhp103:2: One may conquer a thousand men a thousand times in a battle,
dhp103:4: but having conquered one’s own self, one would surely be supreme in battle.
dhp104:1: Conquest over self is better than that over other people,
dhp104:4: for the person who conquers himself, who lives constantly well-restrained,
dhp105:1: neither gods, nor gandhabbas, nor Māra together with Brahmās,
dhp105:4: can turn conquest into defeat for a person who is like this.
dhp106:2: One might give alms impartially with a thousand (coins of money) month by month for a hundred (years);
dhp106:3: and one might worship someone with developed self for a second –
dhp106:6: that worship is surely better than the hundred-year sacrifice.
dhp107:1: One person might care for the fire in the woods for a hundred years;
dhp107:3: and one might worship someone with developed self for a second –
dhp107:6: that worship is surely better than the hundred-year sacrifice.
dhp108:1: Whatever the alms or the sacrifice in the world
dhp108:2: the one seeking merit may give for a year,
dhp108:3: all that comes not to a quarter (of the merit) –
dhp108:4: better is the worship of the upright.
dhp109:1: For the one who is constantly worshipping honourable elders,
dhp109:3: four things increase: the length of life, beauty, happiness, and strength.
dhp110:1: One might live for a hundred years, unvirtuous and uncomposed,
dhp110:4: (but) a life of one day is better, for one with virtue and meditation.
dhp111:1: One might live for a hundred years, lacking in wisdom, uncomposed,
dhp111:4: (but) a life of one day is better, for one endowed with wisdom and meditation.
dhp112:1: One might live for a hundred years, indolent, with less energy,
dhp112:4: (but) a life of one day is better, for one with energy set up and firm.
dhp113:1: One might live for a hundred years without seeing rise and fall,
dhp113:3: (but) a life of one day is better (for the one) seeing rise and fall.
dhp114:1: One might live for a hundred years without seeing the deathless state,
dhp114:3: (but) a life of one day is better (for one) seeing the deathless state.
dhp115:2: One might live for a hundred years without seeing the supreme state,
dhp115:4: (but) a life of one day is better (for one) seeing the supreme state.
